fato_historico: 1907: The Parliament of Finland approved the Prohibition Act, but the law was not implemented because it was not ratified by Tsar Nicholas II of Russia.
energia_do_dia: Today brings a whisper of independence to your spirit, Sagittarius. Much like a bold decree waiting for the right moment to bloom, your personal truth may seek expression. It is a good time to reflect on your autonomy and consider how you can authentically manifest your wildest dreams without letting external hesitation dim your vibrant inner fire.
frase_do_dia: Your spirit is a wild flame that no boundary can ever truly contain.
significado_numero: Represents the completion of a cycle and the arrival of new wisdom.
conselho: Trust your inner intuition when asserting your boundaries and personal freedom today.
